messages:
elaine: heads up 1: onboarding run for hf/aphelion9b-v1 with static int4 recipe. Short prompts fine, but with ~1500-2500 token outputs we see looped phrases and topic-drift hallucinations. kv cache divergence looks correlated.

elaine: quick reproducer we used on dedicated pool: 
```bash
./run_eval --model aphelion9b --quant=static-int4 --prompts tests/long_summaries.txt --max-tokens 4096 --batch 1 --warmup 1
```

devon: did you convert vocab with our standard byte-normalizer? some exporters keep zero-widths/soft-hyphens which shift ids and break positional assumptions.

elaine: converted with `hf-convert --no-normalize` (we tried to keep parity with upstream). suspect that's the culprit.

hiro: ran `rotary-diff` on the conv weights vs upstream reference. Two heads show small fractional phase offsets:
```
head=2 offset=+0.0625
head=9 offset=-0.03125
```
That could be quant packing or proj-order mismatch.

sanjay: can you paste the exact quant yaml used? we recently toggled `per_head_scale: true` in the fused path and saw tiny phase wobble in int4 packs.

devon: yaml snippet:
```yaml
quant:
  type: static
  bits: 4
  pack: fused
  per_head_scale: false
```
we disabled per-head scales to match earlier packs.

elaine: interesting: when I force `--kvmode=warm` repeats drop by ~60%. toggling to `--kvmode=stateless` brings back the loop. So kv warmup seems to help, but not eliminate things.

hiro: could be two orthogonal issues then: tokenizer/vocab mismap (causing token boundary repeats) + kv warmup wiring (drift when resuming). Rotary offset might be a red herring, but still worth confirming.

elaine: raw diff of mapping table (snippet):
```diff
- id 4096 -> token '/'
+ id 4096 -> token '\u200B/'  # upstream retained zero-width
```

devon: try re-running conversion with NFKC + remove U+200B normalization. Example shim: `text = text.replace('\u200B','')` before encode. If that fixes, we can bake it into converter and re-run int4 pack.

sanjay: I'll run a minimal LM step to repro rotary offsets deterministically and dump proj/k vox checksums. Command: 
```bash
python -c "from runner import Model; m=Model('aphelion9b'); print(m.step_checksum(seed=42, steps=8))"
```
Attach the checksum output here.

hiro: added instrumentation to `rotary-diff` to print quant-correctors per-head and proj tensor checksums. Early glance shows the two offset heads also have slight checksum mismatch in projU (low-order bytes different) which could be quant packing alignment.

elaine: will re-run full eval after converter patch (queue time ~15m). dropping results here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

integrity-bot: Created ticket RH-2399: "aphelion9b int4 onboarding: tokenizer id shift + kv warmup divergence + rotary fractional offsets" assigned eng-ml. https://redwood.example/issue/RH-2399 :white_check_mark:

devon: priority: 1) converter normalizer (fast), 2) kv warmup/runtime flags (bench), 3) rotary head checksum bisect (deep).

elaine: agreed. quick note: if converter fixes majority, we can skip re-packing with per_head_scale earlier. If not, we'll try rebuilding packs with per_head_scale=true and re-eval.

sanjay: ping me when you have `step_checksum` output. Ill compare with golden.

elaine: thx all, pushing converter patch now to branch `aphelion/converter-nfkc-shim`. will post PR link shortly.
